sourceNotes.referenceTitle: White Enamel Magnolia Flower Gold Necklace
sourceNotes.rawContent: Capture the essence of spring with this elegant white enamel flower necklace. Featuring pearlescent petals and a detailed gold-toned center, this anti-tarnish pendant hangs from a delicate gold chain for a sophisticated, natural look. It is a timeless accessory that adds a fresh, feminine touch to any outfit
